executionScopes.title: STT provider catalog: VoiceInk parity + NVIDIA Parakeet + streaming-in-chat
executionScopes.description:
## Why this epic

First-class speech-to-text provider catalog for Johnny with the same breadth as VoiceInk (`/Users/nikita/Projects/VoiceInk`), plus NVIDIA Parakeet (`nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3`) as a fast local + streaming-capable option that VoiceInk doesn't ship.

## What ships under this epic

1. **Parakeet provider** (Johnny-stt.1) — `nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3`. Local, fast, streaming-capable. The priority piece.
2. **Catalog UI with Test button** (Johnny-stt.2) — model browser per provider, per-model Test button, latency + cost shown. Mirrors the existing Piper voice catalog UX (`Johnny-ckz.5`).
3. **Live streaming transcription in playground chat** (Johnny-stt.3) — mic icon + live partial transcripts as user speaks. Default: Parakeet local; fallback cloud streaming providers.
4. **VoiceInk parity bundle** (Johnny-stt.4) — Gemini, AssemblyAI, Groq, FluidAudio (P4 backlog). Whisper / Deepgram / ElevenLabs / OpenAI Realtime already exist in `backend/app/providers/`.

## Reference

- VoiceInk providers: `/Users/nikita/Projects/VoiceInk/VoiceInk/Transcription/{Cloud,Streaming,Whisper,FluidAudio}/`
- Existing Johnny providers: `backend/app/providers/{faster_whisper,deepgram,elevenlabs,openai_realtime}_stt.py`
- Parakeet on HuggingFace: https://huggingface.co/nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3

## Out of scope

- Speaker diarization (separate, harder problem).
- Wake-word activation (separate feature).
- Replacing the existing TTS provider catalog (this is STT-only).

## History

Migrated from Johnny-ckz.15 (formerly a child of Johnny-ckz) on 2026-06-06 to live as an independent top-level epic.
